Manipal Entrance Test 2027 Application Details Released

Manipal University has released details regarding the Manipal Entrance Test (MET) 2027. Applicants are required to register online and submit necessary documents. Eligibility criteria vary depending on the specific course. The university has also provided information on application fees and key dates for the upcoming examination.
